# Import photos and videos from Facebook

## In this article

This article discusses a feature that is available to users on Dropbox Basic, Plus, Family, and Professional plans.

You can import photos and videos from Facebook to your Dropbox account using the Facebook data transfer tool.

To import photos or videos from facebook.com or the Facebook mobile app:

Learn how to transfer a copy of your Facebook photos and videos in Facebook’s help center.

Once the transfer is complete, the photos and videos you imported will be saved in a new folder in your Dropbox account. To find the folder on dropbox.com:

Photos and videos will be sorted by album, if applicable.

## FAQs

#### Are my photos and videos still available on Facebook? [...] #### Are my photos and videos still available on Facebook?

Yes. The Transfer a Copy of Your Information process creates copies of your files and saves them in your Dropbox account. All your photos and videos will still be available on Facebook.

#### Will new Facebook photos and videos automatically be backed up to Dropbox after I set up the transfer?

No. The transfer process includes all the photos or videos that exist in your Facebook account at the time you initiate the transfer. To keep your Facebook content up-to-date in Dropbox, you’ll need to import your photos and videos periodically.

#### Will photos and videos go to the same Dropbox folder each time? [...] Each time you back up your Facebook photos and videos, a new folder will be created in your Dropbox account in the Meta folder. The folder will be named “Photo Transfer” or “Video Transfer”, followed by a number. All the photos or videos in your Facebook account will be copied every time you initiate a transfer.

#### Can I use the Facebook data transfer tool to import photos and videos to a Dropbox team account?

No. Currently, the Facebook data transfer tool can’t be used with a Dropbox team plan.

#### Will Facebook have full access to my Dropbox account?

No. When you allow Facebook to transfer a copy of your information and give access your Dropbox account, Facebook will only receive permission to add files to the single Dropbox folder that contains the export.
